They also pointed out that the Commission has consistently disallowed the contingency claims in its order dated 6.1.2020 in Petition No. 178/ GT/ 2017, order dated 8.1.2020 in Petition No.199/GT/2017, and order dated 24.4.2024 in Petition No. 563/GT/2020.
